name: branding-fluid-monoline-wordmark-dark-outline
title: Fluid Wordmark with Outline Letter Backdrop
whatItIs: A light-blue rounded wordmark 'Wyse' with a looping, wavy W and descender, centered on a deep navy field, with giant faint outline letterforms behind it and a small tagline near the bottom.
whatItMeans: The flowing W suggests currents and movement (of markets) while soft blue on midnight feels trustworthy and calm. The huge outline shapes add depth without clutter.
techniques: Monoline letters with a distinctive looped W
Oversized hairline outline of the brand letters as background pattern
Light-blue on navy low-contrast palette with a single bright element
Small tagline set well below the mark for hierarchy
bestFor: Modern tech identities that want softness

vocabulary.definition: A lettering style with uniform stroke thickness.
Oversized faint outlines of brand letters used as a background.
A looping stroke that joins or flourishes a letter.
